title: AI just found 303 new Nazca drawings in Peru. #shorts

scenes.label: SOUTHERN PERU
lines: In the desert of southern Peru, giant drawings have sat on the ground for about two thousand years.
Many are so big, they're best seen from the air.

scenes.label: 2024 · AI SURVEY
lines: About four hundred and thirty figures had been found since 1927.
Then a team from Yamagata University, working with IBM, trained an AI to spot faint outlines in aerial images.
In a six-month field survey, they confirmed three hundred and three new ones. Nearly double.

scenes.label: THE NEW FIGURES
lines: Many are smaller, and sit beside ancient footpaths. People, llamas, birds. Even a killer whale holding a knife.
The team thinks these were meant to be seen by travellers on foot.
So who were the giant ones made for? Follow for one mystery every day.

youtube.title: AI just found 303 new Nazca drawings in Peru. #shorts
youtube.description:
In September 2024, a team led by Masato Sakai of Yamagata University, working with IBM Research, reported 303 previously unknown figurative Nazca geoglyphs found in a six-month field survey, nearly doubling the roughly 430 known before. An AI model flagged candidates in aerial imagery, which were then checked on the ground. The newly found relief-type figures, mostly showing humans and domesticated animals, tend to lie near footpaths, while the larger line-type figures of wild animals sit along the line networks. All visuals are original illustrations.
